Rich only redraws live displays in place when it is writing to a terminal. When output is not a terminal (for example when piped through `tee`), each refresh is printed on a new line. Running the script directly in a terminal, as you found, is the expected behaviour. You can check which mode a console is in with `Console.is_terminal`: https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/console.rst

For further usage questions, please use [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
